builds.label: BV-BRC (PATRIC) annotation only (k/n rebuild vs E3 rebuild)

definitions.gpr_changed: a reaction gene-backed in both drafts whose GPR, as a DNF set over the genes' function strings, differs
definitions.gpr_change_class: fewer_genes: the BV-BRC-only gene set is a strict subset; more_genes: strict superset; same_genes_other_structure; other
definitions.growth_complete_c100: max bio1, KBase complete medium at uptake 100, C uptake <= 100 (flux._max_growth), on the gapfilled model (part-3 record)
definitions.n_added_total: reactions in the gapfilled model that are not in the draft (MSGapfill solution + ATP-correction gapfilling)
definitions.lost_draft_rxn_readded_by_gapfill: draft reactions of the reference arm that the BV-BRC-only draft lacks and its gapfilled model has
